admin_head: 08 - Ministère de la Communication et des Nouvelles Technologies de l'Information
spending_entity: Ministère de la Communication et des Nouvelles Technologies de l'Information
programme: Promotion du numérique dans la production et la fourniture des biens et services
line_name: Promotion du numérique dans la production et la fourniture des biens et services
purpose: The state's programme for promoting digital in the production and supply of goods and services.
scope_basis: The programme's entire stated purpose is the promotion of digital in the production and supply of goods and services; it is one of four programmes in a ministry that also runs media and posts, and those three are separately printed.
amount_scale: full CFA francs as printed; the tables carry no scale factor and the programme column sums to the law's own printed 2,922,218,934,249
doc_locator: Ordonnance n°2025-44, table *Section / Programme / Montant AE / Montant CP*, PDF p. 41, section 08, programme 113
notes: The law prints no source-of-financing column anywhere, so the origin is a flagged inference under the gate's default: domestic-state with funding_source unstated. Crédits de paiement 191,750,009; autorisations d'engagement are the same figure, and an engagement column is context rather than a stage. The four programmes of section 08 sum to the printed section total 4,901,501,946, and the 100 programmes of the budget to the printed 2,922,218,934,249. The ministry's other three are media access (112, 4,186,238,285), its own administration (111) and posts (138), none of which is a digital activity line. A rectificative raising the general budget to about 2,980.54 billion was reported on 2026-08-21; that instrument is not held, so no revised stage is carried here.

admin_head: 912 - Modernisation et transformation numérique de l'Administration Fiscale
spending_entity: Compte spécial 912 - Modernisation et transformation numérique de l'Administration Fiscale
line_name: Modernisation et transformation numérique de l'Administration Fiscale
purpose: The special account funding the digital modernisation of Niger's tax administration.
scope_basis: The account's entire stated purpose is the modernisation and digital transformation of the tax administration; the law authorises it as one line and prints nothing finer.
amount_scale: full CFA francs as printed; the tables carry no scale factor and the programme column sums to the law's own printed 2,922,218,934,249
doc_locator: Ordonnance n°2025-44, article trente-huit (plafonds des comptes spéciaux), PDF p. 39, compte 912
notes: The law prints no source-of-financing column anywhere, so the origin is a flagged inference under the gate's default: domestic-state with funding_source unstated. A compte spécial is authorised with ceilings in both receipts and expenditure, which is the shape of an affected-revenue account, but the law names no revenue for this one, so own-source is not asserted. The seven special accounts sum to the printed 44,228,975,800. **This line is twenty-nine times the digital ministry's own digital programme** and is outside the vote entirely, which is what the spec means by reading the articles and the comptes spéciaux rather than the sector vote.
